import hashlib,json,os,resource,signal,subprocess,sys,time
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from pathlib import Path
from devtools.reference_validator.benchlab_panel import _host

root=Path.cwd();protocol=root/sys.argv[1];base=protocol.parent;spec=json.loads(protocol.read_text());policy=spec['resources']
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{min(os.sched_getaffinity(0))})
for name in ['OMP_NUM_THREADS','OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','MKL_NUM_THREADS','NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS','RAYON_NUM_THREADS','NUMBA_NUM_THREADS']:
 os.environ[name]='1'
os.environ['NUMBA_CACHE_DIR']='/tmp/topomt-validator-native-cache-v1'
os.environ['MPLCONFIGDIR']='/tmp/topomt-validator-mpl-v1'
host=_host();assert host['safe'],'Insufficient conservative host reserve'
source=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain','--','devtools/reference_validator'],text=True).strip()
assert hashlib.sha256(spec['worker_source'].encode()).hexdigest()==spec['worker_sha256']
def limits():
 resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(policy['address_space_limit_bytes'],policy['address_space_limit_bytes']))
 resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(policy['cpu_soft_seconds'],policy['cpu_hard_seconds']))
output=base/'receiving'
command=[sys.executable,'-c',spec['worker_source'],str(protocol),str(output)]
record={'recorded_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'source_revision':source,'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(protocol.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'worker_sha256':spec['worker_sha256'],'resource_policy':policy,'cpu_affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'host_samples':[{'elapsed_seconds':0,'host':host}],'supervisor_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
begin=time.perf_counter();before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);reason=None;termination=None
with (base/'execution.log').open('xb') as log:
 p=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=log,stderr=log,preexec_fn=limits,start_new_session=True)
 while p.poll() is None:
  try:p.wait(timeout=5)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:pass
  elapsed=time.perf_counter()-begin;host=_host();record['host_samples'].append({'elapsed_seconds':elapsed,'host':host})
  if not termination and (not host['safe'] or elapsed>policy['wall_seconds']):
   reason='host_pressure' if not host['safe'] else 'wall_limit';p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);termination=time.perf_counter()
  if termination and time.perf_counter()-termination>30 and p.poll() is None:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
 end=p.wait()
after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
record.update(exit_code=end,stop_reason=reason,elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-begin,child_cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,peak_child_rss_kib_linux=after.ru_maxrss,receiving_status='completed' if end==0 and (output/'receipt.json').is_file() else 'incomplete',log_sha256=hashlib.sha256((base/'execution.log').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
record['files']={str(p.relative_to(base)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in output.rglob('*.json')}
with (base/'execution.json').open('x') as stream:json.dump(record,stream,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({'protocol':str(protocol.relative_to(root)),**{k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ['host_samples','supervisor_source','files']}}),flush=True)
if end:print((base/'execution.log').read_text()[-3000:]);raise SystemExit(end)
